about: AURIX eval set. `plan` tasks check what the planner + fast-lane policy DO with a request (no execution). `code` tasks make the model write a small tool through the forge pipeline and grade it against HIDDEN cases the model never sees. Add tasks freely; keep hidden cases fair (the request must state every rule they test).

tasks.prompt: write a python script that prints the first 10 primes run it and report the output
refactor my parser module and add tests
find the current weather in Denver
list the biggest files in my workspace
summarise the plot of Hamlet in five bullet points
write a python script that emails me the primes
write a script and deploy it to my server
run daily stock trading on my portfolio
convert my CT scan of a skull into an STL
find bug bounty programs on hackerone

tasks.request: Tool `run(args)`. args = {"n": integer >= 0}. Returns a list of the first n prime numbers in ascending order (n = 0 gives an empty list). Raise ValueError if n is not an integer or is negative.

Tool `run(args)`. args = {"text": string}. Splits text on whitespace and returns the words in reverse order joined by single spaces. Text that is empty or only whitespace returns an empty string. Raise ValueError if text is not a string.

Tool `run(args)`. args = {"values": list of numbers in degrees Celsius}. Returns a list of the same length with each value converted to Fahrenheit (c * 9 / 5 + 32). An empty list returns an empty list. Raise ValueError if values is not a list or any item is not a number.

Tool `run(args)`. args = {"text": string}. Returns a dict mapping each word to how many times it occurs. A word is a whitespace-separated token, lowercased, with the characters . , ! ? removed from BOTH ends of the token. Empty text returns an empty dict. Raise ValueError if text is not a string.

args.text: The cat, the dog. THE end!

tasks.request: Tool `run(args)`. args = {"n": integer >= 1}. Returns a list of n strings for 1..n: "FizzBuzz" if divisible by both 3 and 5, "Fizz" if divisible by 3, "Buzz" if divisible by 5, otherwise the number as a string. Raise ValueError if n is not an integer or is less than 1.

Tool `run(args)`. args = {"items": list of integers}. Returns the items sorted ascending with duplicates removed. An empty list returns an empty list. Raise ValueError if items is not a list or contains anything that is not an integer.

Tool `run(args)`. args = {"text": string}. Returns true if text reads the same forwards and backwards when case and every non-alphanumeric character are ignored; the empty string is a palindrome (true). Raise ValueError if text is not a string.

args.text: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

tasks.request: Tool `run(args)`. args = {"start": "YYYY-MM-DD", "end": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Returns the number of days from start to end as an integer (negative if end is before start). Raise ValueError if either value is not a string or is not a valid calendar date in that format.
